jobs.description:
Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects. You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

jobs.occupation: Scrum Master - Master of the subject - Financial Services
jobs.description:
SENIOR SCRUM MASTER - Masterize the subject - Brussels

This is not a classic Scrum Master position focused solely on ceremonies and Agile rituals.

You will take a senior, hands-on role within a large Agile environment, with responsibility for improving processes, challenging existing ways of working and bringing real added value through your expertise.

Being Senior means going beyond what is asked of you: taking ownership, identifying opportunities for improvement, making recommendations and actively contributing to better ways of working.

A key part of the role will also be budget follow-up and financial tracking, a responsibility that typically sits with a Project Manager.

You will work closely with Squad Leads and stakeholders to improve team effectiveness and delivery performance.

Senior Scrum Master - the job:

You will…

• Drive Agile practices while challenging and continuously improving processes, ways of working and team effectiveness.
• Take ownership of budget follow-up and financial tracking, alongside the usual Scrum Master responsibilities.
• Coach and support teams and stakeholders, going beyond facilitation to bring your own expertise and proactively improve delivery.

Senior Scrum Master - your profile:

You are/have…

• Strong Senior Scrum Master experience, with a proven ability to go beyond ceremonies and proactively improve processes.
• A solid understanding of IT development lifecycles, including design, development and testing.
• A genuine Senior mindset: you take ownership, challenge the status quo and bring added value through your expertise.
• A hands-on, communicative and flexible personality, with a strong team spirit and a constructive approach to compromise.
• Fluent English.

Our client is an engineering company.

1. IT Infrastructure Governance & Strategy

• Assess business and end-user needs, as well as quality, operational, and security requirements.
• Translate business requirements into IT solutions and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Design, maintain, and continuously improve the local IT infrastructure architecture in alignment with business objectives and Group standards.
• Advise management on IT strategy, technology evolution, infrastructure investments, and risk mitigation.
• Monitor emerging technologies and recommend improvements to systems, services, and operational efficiency.
• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, licensing, and corporate requirements.

2. User Support & Service Delivery

• Provide technical support to end-users through telephone, e-mail, remote assistance, and face-to-face interventions.
• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and system-related issues.
• Assist end-users in the effective use of IT equipment, systems, and applications.
• Deliver user guidance and training when required.
• Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Document support procedures and maintain an up-to-date knowledge base.

3. Infrastructure Operations & Maintenance

• Design, implement, operate, and maintain local IT infrastructure including servers, networks, endpoints, and associated services.
• Ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of IT systems and infrastructure.
• Manage backup, recovery, monitoring, and business continuity mechanisms.
• Perform infrastructure updates, upgrades, patch management, and corrective maintenance activities.
• Maintain accurate technical documentation, inventory records, system configurations, and operational procedures.
• Ensure the smooth operation of all IT services, including network services, endpoint management, printing services, e-mail systems, and security tools.

4. Cybersecurity & Compliance

• Support the development, implementation, maintenance, and monitoring of the cybersecurity policies, procedures, and controls in accordance with legal, regulatory, customer, and Group requirements.
• Continuously assess and improve the security posture of systems, applications, and infrastructure.
• Ensure the effective operation of security solutions, including endpoint protection, access control, monitoring, backup, and recovery systems.
• Contribute to security audits, compliance assessments, and corrective action plans.
• Participate in the management of cybersecurity incidents and crisis situations involving complex infrastructure or software issues.

Profile

• A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
• A minimum of five years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or a comparable role.
• Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Windows environments, Microsoft 365, Active Directory or Entra ID, networking, endpoint management, backup and recovery, virtualization, and infrastructure monitoring.
• Practical knowledge of cybersecurity controls, vulnerability and patch management, access control, endpoint protection, incident response, and secure infrastructure configuration.
• Experience providing remote and on-site end-user support and managing incidents, service requests, technical documentation, and SLAs.
• Experience managing IT suppliers, licenses, assets, procurement activities, and budget-related processes.
• Experience with ISO 27001 implementation is a strong plus.
• Proven ability to operate independently as a local IT point of contact while collaborating effectively with centralised Group IT functions.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder-management, and organisational skills.
• Professional fluency in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an advantage.
• Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and provide support outside standard working hours when required.
• Relevant Microsoft, networking, ITIL, or cybersecurity certifications are considered an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Senior CAPEX Project Manager Process Industry
jobs.description:
Project overview

In this position, you take the lead on large-scale multidisciplinary CAPEX projects in the process industry. You are responsible for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety, both for greenfield investments and for major upgrades or modifications to existing industrial installations.

Primary tasks & responsibilities

• Manage industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept definition through engineering, execution, commissioning and final transfer to operations.
• Establish and control project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline scheduling in MS Project.
• Oversee every project stage, including pre-studies, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, site activities, commissioning and operational handover.
• Serve as the main point of accountability for stakeholders and management throughout the full project lifecycle.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams covering mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS domains, in collaboration with internal and external partners.
• Handle scope changes, risks, claims and deviations with impact on budget, planning or delivery.
• Provide structured progress reporting on status, issues and key decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with demonstrable end-to-end responsibility for industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is essential.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and take full ownership of project planning rather than limiting yourself to follow-up alone.
• You combine an academic level of thinking with strong analytical capabilities and a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work independently and take full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You demonstrate strong leadership and are able to challenge stakeholders and contractors when needed.
• You communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

About the Client
Oliver James has partnered with a fast-growing, cloud-first European SaaS scale-up currently navigating the second phase of its internal AI transformation. Moving from decentralised pilots to a secure, enterprise-wide adoption model, their Internal IT and Data teams are bringing in a hands-on Internal AI & Governance Expert to bridge strategy, hands-on development, and change management.

Note: This role focuses exclusively on internal workflow optimisation, SaaS integrations, and internal web applications - no customer data or core product development involved.
Key Responsibilities
• Governance & Ways of Working: Refine internal AI governance frameworks, security standards, and development analytics suited for a regulated QMS environment.
• Business Challenge & ROI: Actively engage cross-functional stakeholders to interrogate the business logic and clear ROI behind requested AI tools before implementation.
• Hands-on Integration & Development: Partner closely with internal IT and Data teams to build and integrate AI capabilities into internal web applications using Python, TypeScript, and Git.
• Cloud Infrastructure: Leverage Azure AI tools (Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry, Machine Learning) to deploy secure internal automation.
• Enablement & Knowledge Transfer: Demystify AI tools and technical concepts for non-technical teams, passing down practical knowledge to support adoption without line-management responsibilities.
• Program Support: Support key 2026 roadmap initiatives, including internal AI Knowledge Bases, AI Champions programs, and role-specific training modules.
Candidate Profile
• Governance & Adoption Strategy: Proven background scaling AI governance, data safety, and operational frameworks within SaaS or cloud-first setups.
• Technical Stack: Strong hands-on coding skills in Python and TypeScript, proficiency with Git, and direct experience building with Azure AI infrastructure.
• Web App Integration: Demonstrated experience integrating AI capabilities into web platforms alongside internal IT/Data engineering teams.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Confident challenging business requests, defining clear ROI, and translating technical architectures into plain language.
• Regulated/QMS Exposure: Previous exposure to regulated, quality-driven, or compliance-heavy environments is highly preferred.
• Fluency: Full professional proficiency in English.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Zottegem.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.

You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.
Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system:
 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You are stress-resistant and thrive in a production environment where pace is important. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

Sunday: 22:00–06:00
Monday: 22:00–06:00
Tuesday: 22:00–06:00
Wednesday: 22:00–06:00
Thursday: 22:00–06:00
 
• You have some previous experience in a production environment, preferably in the food industry. 
• You are available to start soon. 
• You speak Dutch and/or English fluently. 
• You are conscientious and enjoy working efficiently. 
• You are an excellent multitasker. 
• You can work well both independently and as part of a team. 
• Working at a fast pace is not a problem for you. 
• You are enthusiastic and eager to learn. 
• You are specifically looking for a job on a permanent night shift. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

• Fluency in English and German
• Ideally your are immediately available

The Office Manager ensures the smooth daily operation of the shopping centre through administrative management, coordination with internal teams and tenants, and professional reception of visitors. They support management with reporting, agenda management and information handling, while maintaining accurate records and ensuring efficient communication across the site.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day‑to‑day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

 

Omschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow‑up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision‑making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

 

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands‑on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping‑centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time‑management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

The role ensures accurate data management, timely processing of purchase orders, and effective coordination between suppliers, warehouse, and internal teams to maintain efficient material flow and stock availability.

Client Details

The company operates in the pharmaceutical sector.

Description

As a Planning and Procurement Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Manage purchase orders and maintain accurate planning, purchasing, and ERP data.
• Coordinate with suppliers on orders, deliveries, documentation, and issue resolution.
• Monitor inventory levels and support inbound logistics and delivery tracking.
• Prepare reports, maintain records, and support KPI monitoring and data accuracy.
• Collaborate with planning, warehouse, logistics, customer service, and finance teams to support daily supply chain operations and follow up on action items.

A successful Planning and Procurement Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• 1-2 years of experience in an administrative, logistics, purchasing, or supply chain support role.
• Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP, JD Edwards, or similar) and good command of Microsoft Excel.
• Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, and administrative organization.
• Effective communication skills with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Ability to prioritize tasks, work in a fast-paced environment, and collaborate across teams.
• Proactive, reliable, and team-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in both French and English (written and spoken).
